archive_order.episodic: oldest event_time then episode_id within each user

consolidation.organisation_promotion: deterministic human review plus at least two independent supporting episodes, or trusted-document evidence
consolidation.semantic_strength_formula: support + successful_reuse + independent_user_evidence + recent_verification - negative_transfer - contradiction - version_staleness
consolidation.verified_semantic_source_rule: verified successful source only; a single verified episode may create a private user-semantic candidate but cannot self-publish organisation-wide

development_freeze_rule.checkpoint_selection: run each of the four preregistered full-policy candidates over all 12 development targets in exact order, select by resolved desc then actual total tokens asc then actual USD asc then candidate_id asc, and freeze only the selected candidate's final DoubleDQN checkpoint
development_freeze_rule.heldout_visibility: forbidden until the selected full policy, selected RuntimeLock and selected final checkpoint are hash-linked in a new committed freeze and separately approved
development_freeze_rule.pending_credit_finalization: after development target 11, deterministically credit every still-pending memory with no-reuse reward = -0.05 * normalized_context_cost

double_dqn.network: pure-python one-hidden-layer ReLU online and target networks

heuristic_warm_start.reason: No synthetic demonstration set is introduced after target selection; development learns only from the preregistered stream.

retrieval.retrieval_point: exactly when a semantic subtask becomes active
retrieval.self_memory_exclusion: source_task_id equal to current target task_id is excluded before ranking
